items.title: Brad Gerstner Sees Anthropic at “$3 Trillion in Total Enterprise Value” by Late 2027. Here’s What It Takes
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBrad Gerstner sees Anthropic reaching about $3 trillion in enterprise value by late 2027 if investors value it at 10x projected 2028 revenue. That needs about $300 billion of 2028 revenue, 32% more than the $228 billion analysts expect.

items.title: Jason Calacanis Will “Catch Every Knife” With SpaceX, Tesla and Google. Only Some Are Cheap
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStocks had their worst week of 2026, and angel investor Jason Calacanis said he’ll put any free cash he has into SpaceX, Tesla, Uber, Shopify and Google. He says big tech trades at its lowest P/Es since the dot-com era.

items.title: Billionaire David Tepper Just Made a Massive AI Chip Rotation — Will It Pay Off?
items.summary: Tepper was selling shares of AMD, Broadcom, and Alphabet in Q3, while buying Nvidia and Micron.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Has Crashed 48% and Now Trades at 15 Times Earnings, Its Cheapest in More Than a Decade and Cheaper Than Microsoft and Broadcom
items.summary: Nvidia closed 48% below its record on Friday and trades at 15 times its last four quarters of earnings, the lowest since at least 2014 and less than Microsoft or Broadcom. Here is what that price assumes and why the market doubts the earnings.

items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh AI Spending And Monetization
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Alphabet has been trimmed from US$408.09 to US$397.13, signalling a modest reset in how analysts are framing the stock. This shift aligns with fresh research that weighs heavy AI spending in Search, Google Cloud and custom TPUs against questions about near term monetization, margins and capital intensity. items.title: AppLovin vs. Reddit: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: AppLovin is growing fast and is highly profitable, but its stock has been volatile. Reddit is profitable and still growing, but Google's AI search is sending it fewer visitors.

items.title: Alphabet Stock Just Hit a 1-Year Low. Why Is Google's Parent Borrowing So Much Money?
